feedback.problem:
Solve the following system of equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}0.09v-0.04w=0.05 \\ 0.02v-0.01w=0.2\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
To get rid of the decimals, we multiply both equations by $100,$ as follows:

$$
{\begin{aligned}0.09v-0.04w=0.05 & |\times 100 \\ 0.02v-0.01w=0.2 & |\times 100\end{aligned}\,⟹\,{\begin{aligned}9v-4w=5 \\ 2v-w=20\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that if we multiply the second equation by $-4,$ we will get a $4w$ term that can cancel with the $-4w$ term in the first equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}9v-4w=5 &  \\ 2v-w=20 & |\,\times (-4)\end{aligned}\,⟹\,{\begin{aligned}9v-4w=5 \\ -8v+4w=-80\end{aligned}
$$

Adding the two equations eliminates the $w$-variable and allows us to solve for $v:$

$$
\begin{aligned}9v-\cancel{4w} & =5 \\ -8v+\cancel{4w} & =-80 \\ (9v-8v) & =(5-80) \\ v & =-75\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we can substitute $v=-75$ into the equation $2v-w=20$ to solve for $w:$

$$
\begin{aligned}2v-w & =20 \\ 2(-75)-w & =20 \\ -150-w & =20 \\ -w & =170 \\ w & =-170\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the system of equations is $v=-75,\,w=-170.$
